ideas.pitch: Low-cost augmented reality chemistry and physics experiments designed to run on budget Android smartphones for rural schools lacking physical lab equipment.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital/virtual laboratories and VR/AR-based learning for rural and underserved school students.
ideas.title: LabInABox AR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets rural accessibility and low-bandwidth constraints, matching the explicit judging criteria for inclusivity and impact.

ideas.pitch: A 2D web-based RPG that teaches high school biology and chemistry through interactive cellular and molecular puzzle-solving.
ideas.problem_statement: Gamified STEM education and experiential learning in biology and chemistry.
ideas.title: BioQuest Gamified
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an engaging, fully functional live demo that captivates judges during the 2 progress reviews.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice assistant that guides struggling rural students through step-by-step mathematical problem solving using vernacular speech recognition.
ideas.problem_statement: Interactive STEM learning in mathematics for underserved school students.
ideas.title: FormulaFlow Voice Math
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major language and accessibility barrier for rural students, appealing heavily to the accessibility and social impact judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: A browser-based drag-and-drop physics circuit simulator with real-time AI feedback explaining why circuits fail or succeed.
ideas.problem_statement: Technology-enabled STEM learning and digital laboratories for physics education.
ideas.title: CircuitCraft Web
ideas.why_it_could_win: Extremely practical for schools with no hardware budget, providing immediate visual proof of concept during live judging.

ideas.pitch: A cardboard VR-compatible ecosystem simulator where students manipulate environmental variables to study biology and ecology impacts.
ideas.problem_statement: VR/AR-based learning and experiential biology education for rural schools.
ideas.title: EcoHabitat VR Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages immersive VR technology on low-cost Google Cardboard, showing high innovation while maintaining practical classroom feasibility.
